name: application-rate-limit-notice
title: Rate Limit Notice
description: Cooldown notice components with a countdown to retry availability, for API rate limits and throttled actions.
useWhen: Cooldown notice components with a countdown to retry availability, for API rate limits and throttled actions.
avoidWhen: Avoid rate limit notice when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Rate Limit Notice uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
